title: BUSTED: The Citizen's Guide to Surviving Police Encounters
summary: A 45-minute Flex Your Rights documentary on how to deal with police in three situations: traffic stops, encounters at home, and on the street. It presents practical advice on asserting constitutional rights and refusing searches.
why: Recommended as a practical guide to knowing your rights during police encounters, alongside the well-known advice to not talk to the cops.

quote.text: Excellent 45 minute ACLU documentary on how to interact with police in three situations: traffic stop, in your house, and on foot.
